description: This file defines an interface 'Zend_Http_UserAgent_Device' for representing browser device types within the Zend Framework HTTP package. It specifies methods for interacting with device features, browser info, and capabilities.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Device
classes.description: An interface for browser device type representation, specifying methods for device features, capabilities, and browser info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor allowing injection of user agent, server array, and config array, or seeding from serialized data.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Static method to attempt matching a user agent string to device signatures.

methods.name: getAllFeatures
methods.description: Retrieve all features of the device.

methods.name: getAllGroups
methods.description: Retrieve all feature groups associated with the device.

methods.name: hasFeature
methods.description: Check if the device has a specific feature.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Get the value of a specific device feature.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Retrieve features associated with a specific group.

methods.name: hasPhoneNumber
methods.description: Check if the device has an associated phone number.
